-- script --
option layout columns
start /home/evan/projects/gloss

snapshot start
note click in the column above: go there, the row clicked selected
click 3 3
state dir /home/evan/projects
state current tiny
snapshot clicked-above
note the columns have moved with it: the first now lists evan
click 3 3
state dir /home/evan
state current projects
note click a row in the last column: descend into that folder, the row chosen
click 60 2
state dir /home/evan/projects
state current gloss
snapshot clicked-beside
